taskVersion.name: ves-real-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station Kenpoly-convocation-arena (Bori Metropolis). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 1434 | 2.5 | 2.5
2 | 1879 | 5.42 | 7.92
3 | 318 | 18 | 25.9
4 | 3488 | 24.3 | 50.2
5 | 542 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as KHK-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: Kenpoly-convocation-arena (Bori Metropolis)
Curve type: KHK
Aquifer depth: 25.9 m – 50.2 m
Recommendation: The resistive fourth layer (≈3488 Ω·m, 25.9–50.2 m) represents the main water-bearing horizon; case off the overlying conductive clay/shale layer (318 Ω·m) and set screens within the 25.9–50.2 m interval, while monitoring for the underlying low-resistivity (542 Ω·m) unit that may indicate a confining or saline base layer.
